description:
Workspace-wide propagation of two tasks-server fixes (JMAP-h47t.18 + JMAP-h47t.19) to the canonical jmap-mail-server and the remaining 6 extension-server siblings.

Both patterns appear identically in every *-server crate's reference MemoryBackend:

Pattern 1: MemoryError(pub String) tuple struct
  Lock the maintainer out of adding kind/source fields. Convert to struct
  MemoryError { msg: String } + pub fn new(impl Into<String>) -> Self +
  pub fn message(&self) -> &str. Internal call sites migrate to ::new(...).

Pattern 2: #[derive(Clone)] on Arc<Mutex<Inner>> MemoryBackend
  Casual reader sees derive(Clone) and expects deep-copy semantics; actual
  behavior is shared-state via Arc::clone. Replace with manual Clone impl
  whose rustdoc states the contract (handler registration depends on
  Arc-clone semantics so this can never become deep-copy without a wider
  redesign).

Affected crates:
  jmap-mail-server      (canonical — change first)
  jmap-chat-server
  jmap-calendars-server
  jmap-contacts-server
  jmap-filenode-server
  jmap-metadata-server
  jmap-sharing-server

Per-crate steps:
  1. memory.rs: replace MemoryError(pub String) → struct + new/message.
  2. memory.rs: rg 'MemoryError\(' → migrate to MemoryError::new(.
  3. memory.rs: replace #[derive(Clone)] on the backend struct with a
     manual impl Clone block that documents the shared-state contract.
  4. Module rustdoc: tighten the 'Cloning is cheap' line to reference the
     manual Clone impl and call out 'shared-state' explicitly.
  5. cargo fmt + clippy + test + cargo doc -D warnings per crate.

No behavior change in either pattern — Display impl + Arc-clone semantics
are preserved. The visible difference is on docs.rs (Clone semantics now
attached to the impl block, not buried in a module-level paragraph) and
in the API surface (MemoryError's field is no longer pub, so a future
addition of structured fields is non-breaking).

Cross-references: JMAP-h47t.18 + JMAP-h47t.19 closed against tasks-server.
title: workspace canonical-template sweep: MemoryBackend tightening across all *-server crates (private error field, manual Clone with shared-state docs)
